### Downloads

- **macOS**: `.dmg` (universal — Intel and Apple Silicon)
- **Windows**: `.msi` or the NSIS `-setup.exe`

These binaries are **not code-signed**. macOS Gatekeeper will refuse the first
launch — right-click the app and choose *Open*, or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/EDID Editor.app"`.
Windows SmartScreen will warn; choose *More info* → *Run anyway*.
